_comment: Package-scoped post-gix-removal transitive-dependency baseline for the heddle-cli crate (default features, normal edges only). Tracked by scripts/check-cli-dep-count.sh and wired into Rust Tests' Static contracts job. The gate FAILS if the live count exceeds baseline + slack; raise the baseline (with justification) only when a dependency addition is deliberate. The 423 baseline reflects transitional duplicate RustCrypto generations from heddle-api alpha.46+ and heddle's older crypto stack, already present on main 0b5eec40; tracked in HeddleCo/heddle#2094 to unify and lower again.
